title: Family with Baby on Blue Ridge Parkway, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot
description: A crisp black and white snapshot dated September 24, 1950, showing a family taking a scenic road trip stop along the Blue Ridge Parkway. A young mother in a collared dress and father in a tie sit atop a wooden sign structure holding their baby, with a stone arch bridge and winding parkway road visible in the background.
